column1: # Turkish (tr) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Turkish video-editing vocabulary (zaman çizelgesi, parça, klip, sekans, kutu, oynatma kafası,
# işaretçi, geçiş, anahtar kare). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands use the imperative ("Farklı
# Kaydet…"), labels keep the English capitalisation, and product and format names (CFA4,
# Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review
# is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klip, track = parça, sequence = sekans, timeline = zaman çizelgesi, bin = kutu,
# playhead = oynatma kafası, marker = işaretçi, In/Out point = giriş/çıkış noktası, keyframe =
# anahtar kare, caption = altyazı, preset = ön ayar, workspace = çalışma alanı, render = işle,
# ripple = kaydırarak, slide = kaydırarak taşı, slip = sıyır, dissolve = çözülme, wipe = silme,
# highlights = parlak tonlar, (Legacy) = (Eski).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see tr.tsv.attribution.
